items.title: Matt Shumer (@mattshumer_)
items.summary: The fact that @0xRishi was able to accomplish this in a few days using Opus 5 & @mattshumer_ gauntlet loop all web native using @threejs blows my mind! Downloaded it as a chrome app & it was only 2.8 MB… 🤯😱 Even supports my Xbox One controller connected to my MacBook Pro. 😳 Video Rishi (@0xRishi) Introducing Modern Claudefare Built fully with Opus 5 on High Mode over a few days using principles from @mattshumer_ ’s Gauntlet Loop - 84,100 lines of code Includes remakes of 4 beloved maps: 0:00 - Rust 0:40 - Highrise 0:57 - Nuketown 1:26 - Terminal Solo & multiplayer (w/ voice chat), bots included Tools used: - @threejs as core Javascript 3D library (all 20 guns and 4 maps generated by the model in code) - @MeshyAI for 3D models + rigging + animations of 8 soldiers, 1 helicopter (highrise) and 1 bus (nuketown) - @ElevenLabs for 430+ SFX, Music & TTS generations Play it now at modernclaudefare.com (More details in thread) Video — https://nitter.net/0xRishi/status/2084322235788226653#m
